build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that places a ball above an obstacle bar to reach the ground
create_obstacle_bar: create a static bar obstacle with configurable width, x position, and y position in the scene
add_dynamic_ball: add a dynamic ball centered on top of an obstacle in the PHYRE scene
define_spatial_relationship: define a touching spatial relationship between the ball and the bottom wall as the task goal
set_solution_tier: set the solution tier to BALL for the task metadata in the PHYRE creator
